description: This file defines the ContactDetailActivity class which extends FragmentActivity. It manages the display of contact details by hosting a ContactDetailFragment, handles intent data for contact URIs, manages action bar navigation, and includes debugging tools in development builds.

classes.name: ContactDetailActivity
classes.description: A FragmentActivity that displays contact details within a fragment, manages navigation actions, and initializes the contact detail fragment based on intent data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up debug mode, retrieves contact URI from intent, manages fragment addition, and enables 'up' navigation.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically navigating 'up' via NavUtils when the home button is pressed.
